reasoning_content:
The build script is interactive - it waits for input. It seemingly exited 0 but didn't actually build because readline got EOF from piped input. Let me run the actual vite build directly, non-interactively.

The build script runs: `cross-env PORTAL_FOLDER=portal vite build --config devtools/vite.config.js && rimraf dist/portal`

Let me run that directly.

action.command: cd /workspace && export PATH=/opt/node/bin:$PATH && timeout 590 npx cross-env PORTAL_FOLDER=portal npx vite build --config devtools/vite.config.js 2>&1 | tail -60; echo "EXIT=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"
